title: Qué Hay Puebla
subtitle: A directory for local businesses in Puebla. Owners sign up on their own, pick a plan, and get a dashboard with their numbers.
about:
What is Qué Hay Puebla?

Most small businesses in Puebla don't have a website and don't rank anywhere useful on Google. Qué Hay Puebla is a directory built around the city: owners can sign up on their own, choose a plan, and manage their listing, photos, and analytics from a single dashboard. Everything is self-serve, including billing.

challenge.title: The problem: local businesses with no online presence
challenge.description: The city has thousands of small businesses that live on WhatsApp groups and word of mouth. Any product for them has to be cheap, easy to sign up for, and not require a sales call.

cards.title: No search layer for the city
cards.description: Google is noisy and most of these businesses don't rank. Users were asking around in WhatsApp groups to find anything.

cards.title: Manual onboarding doesn't scale
cards.description: If every new business needs an admin to approve it, growth stops. Onboarding had to be entirely self-serve.

cards.title: Billing without a sales team
cards.description: Charging small businesses means being transparent. The site needed clear plans, free trials, and a billing portal they could run themselves.

solution.title: The solution: a self-serve platform
solution.description: The platform handles the whole lifecycle on its own: a business owner signs up, picks a tier, pays through Stripe, and lands on a dashboard with analytics and media tools gated by their plan.

features.title: Four plans, Stripe-backed
features.description: A free Starter and three paid tiers ($299, $599, $999 MXN/mo). 7-day trials, annual discounts, and a self-service portal for upgrades and cancels.

features.title: Interactive map by zone
features.description: A Leaflet map that clusters pins across eight city zones. Pins are styled by tier and sorted by distance from the user.

features.title: Features gated by plan
features.description: One config file controls what every tier gets: photo limits, analytics frequency, delivery links, Instagram mentions, and the random-discovery feature.

features.title: Analytics the owner can read
features.description: Tracks views, phone taps, WhatsApp taps, website clicks, directions and shares. Reporting frequency scales with the plan.

techStack.title: How it's built
techStack.description: Next.js 15 App Router on top of Postgres, with Stripe handling billing.

categories.name: Framework
categories.description: Next.js 15 App Router with Server Components and Server Actions. Middleware protects every /panel route.

categories.name: Auth
categories.description: NextAuth.js v5 with Google, Facebook and email/password. Three roles: consumer, business owner, admin.

categories.name: Billing
categories.description: Stripe Checkout and the Customer Portal. Trial starts, upgrades, downgrades and cancels are handled through webhooks.

categories.name: Rate limiting
categories.description: Upstash Redis with three profiles: strict for auth, standard for mutations, relaxed for reads. Zod on every input.

results.title: No admin per signup
results.description: Onboarding, approval and billing all run themselves.

results.title: Full billing lifecycle on autopilot
results.description: Stripe webhooks handle trials, upgrades, downgrades and cancels. Tier limits apply instantly.

results.title: SEO that works per-business
results.description: Dynamic sitemap, LocalBusiness JSON-LD, Open Graph, and an llms.txt file. Everything generated server-side per listing.
